task.title: Rewrite templates/agents/pr-reviewer.md to sign tasks via MCP validation_record only; drop Edit tool
task.description:
Rewrite `templates/agents/pr-reviewer.md` so that sign-off is entirely MCP-driven and the spec file stays read-only.
**Frontmatter changes:** - `tools:` — remove `Edit`. New list: `Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Task`. (Justification: there is no longer ANY file pr-reviewer should edit. Sign-off is `validation_record`. Status flips to 'closed' are an architect responsibility per the new flow — pr-reviewer only records pass/fail.) - `description:` — drop "closes tasks by editing their XML". Update to: "Pre-commit and pre-push review gate. Delegates mechanical review to pr-review-toolkit:review-pr, overlays TMB task-alignment checks, records pass/fail via MCP validation_record. PROJECT-LEVEL PLACEHOLDER — edit to match your domain."
**Section A. Role:** Update one line. Old: "Your verdict determines whether a task moves from `status="completed"` to `status="closed"`." New: "Your verdict (recorded via MCP `validation_record`) determines whether the architect can flip the task to `status='closed'`."
**Section C. TMB Overlay — Task-Alignment Checks:** - Item 1 Scope alignment: cite the markdown spec's `## Files` section instead of `<scope>`. - Item 2 Success criteria met: cite the markdown spec's `## Success Criteria` and `## Verification` sections instead of `<success-criteria>` and `<verification>`. If either section is missing or empty → FAIL the review. - Item 3 Atomic-close discipline (#W4): the check is now "MCP `tasks` row for this branch_id has `status='completed'` (set by SWE)". If still `status='running'` → FAIL the review with #W4 violation. - Item 4 Already closed: query MCP `task_get`. If `status='closed'` → report and return.
**Section D. Sign-Off — On PASS:** Old (XML edit + status flip + validation_record): New (MCP only): ``` 1. Generate a snapshot for the human review trail: issue_snapshot_md(issue_id, output_path='docs/trustmybot/snapshots/<issue_id>.md') 2. Call MCP validation_record(task_id=<tasks.id>, attempt_n=N+1, agent='pr-reviewer', verdict='pass', feedback_md='LGTM'). 3. Return control to architect with the verdict. Architect calls task_update_status(status='closed'). Do NOT edit the spec file. Do NOT flip task status yourself. ```
**Section D. Sign-Off — On FAIL:** Old (write <review-findings> XML block): New: ``` 1. Call MCP validation_record(verdict='fail', feedback_md=<structured findings>). 2. Optionally append a discussion entry via discussion_append( issue_id, author='pr-reviewer', kind='note', body_md=findings). 3. Return control to architect for the retry loop. State clearly what SWE must fix. Do NOT edit the spec file. ```
**Section E. Edit-Tool Discipline (#W2):** REPLACE the section title and body. New title: "**E. No-Edit Discipline (#W2)**". Body:
``` pr-reviewer has NO Edit tool. All sign-off is via MCP validation_record. Spec files at docs/trustmybot/tasks/*.md are read-only to pr-reviewer. Snapshot files at docs/trustmybot/snapshots/*.md are written via MCP issue_snapshot_md, never via Edit/Write.
If you find yourself wanting to edit any file, stop — that is outside your authority. Escalate to architect instead. ```
**Error Handling table:** update to drop XML-specific rows; add MCP rows. - "validation_record MCP call fails" → retry once, then escalate to architect (no filesystem fallback — DB is authoritative now). - "MCP tasks row not found for branch_id" → escalate to architect (spec exists but not registered; #W4 violation). - "Spec markdown missing `## Success Criteria` or `## Verification`" → FAIL the review; spec was underspecified.
Cite `docs/trustmybot/SPEC-FORMAT.md` once.
Keep the placeholder banner intact.

files.file: Per-section rewrite per description. Update frontmatter (drop `Edit` from tools, update description). Replace Section D sign-off bodies. Replace Section E header + body. Update Error Handling table. Net length should hold roughly steady.

task.success-criteria: - Frontmatter `tools:` no longer contains `Edit`. - Frontmatter `description:` no longer mentions "editing their XML". - File no longer contains `<reviewed-by>`, `<closed-by>`, `<review-findings>`, or `*.xml` references for task specs. - File contains `validation_record` as the canonical sign-off mechanism. - File contains `issue_snapshot_md` for the snapshot generation step. - File contains "spec files at docs/trustmybot/tasks/*.md are read-only" or equivalent prohibition. - Section E renamed to "No-Edit Discipline" or similar. - File still contains the placeholder banner. - File cites `docs/trustmybot/SPEC-FORMAT.md`. - Length: 110-180 lines.
task.out-of-scope: - Modifying the `validation_record` MCP tool itself (already exists — Phase 0). - Modifying `pr-review-toolkit` plugin (external dependency). - Editing review-protocol or review-findings skills (Phase 2 task `skills-rewrite`). - Changing how architect calls task_update_status to close a task after pr-reviewer passes (architect template task handles this).

task.commit:

Phase 2 pr-reviewer signs tasks exclusively via MCP validation_record (verdict pass/fail) instead of editing XML task files. Generates review-time snapshots via issue_snapshot_md.
